title: Add Popup-Approved Local Clearance Creation Tool
summary: Implemented a popup-approved MCP tool to create one short-lived, single-use operator-local execution clearance artifact without requiring the operator to paste and run a Python script. The tool validates the structured approval evidence first, refuses if approval is invalid, expired, unusable, or consumed, checks target workspace branch/commit/clean state and request artifact commit binding, writes only .local/forgepilot/execution-clearance.json in the MCP bridge workspace, and immediately reuses the read-only observer to validate that the created clearance is eligible. The tool does not consume approval, clear the disable switch, contact the runner start endpoint, start OpenCode, or run FP-027.
caveats: The running MCP service must be restarted before this new tool is available in ChatGPT.
This tool intentionally relaxes the earlier strict FP-MCP-217 manual-shell boundary in favor of explicit popup-approved local clearance creation.
The created clearance remains local, short-lived, exact-scoped, single-use, and bound to approval/request/model/run mode/branch/commits/workspace.
The tool may overwrite an existing local clearance artifact; this is reported as clearanceMutated true.
No canary or runner start was attempted by this packet.
Existing FP-MCP-230 approval and local clearances are expired and must not be reused.
